CustomField.label: Scheduled Expert
CustomField.description: Set by the "Schedule Expert Call" prototype in the Salesforce-in-Teams record page when an agent picks a suggested time slot. Deliberately not a Case Owner reassignment - most Expert__c prototype records have no Linked_User__c (no real Salesforce User), so there's nothing valid to reassign Owner to. This field is the real, honest record of the scheduling decision instead.
